text: Week 1 lift day: power clean 135 lb 5x4, back squat 4x10 at 155 lb, RDL about 155 lb.
Power clean about 130-135 lb, back squat 4x10 at 155 lb with a 3 s lowering. Hip thrust on the machine: set 1 at 270 lb of plates, sets 2-3 at 320 lb.
Lying hamstring curl at 85 lb was too heavy; aiming for about 70-75 lb for 3x10.
Jump day: 10 penultimate-step cone reps, a slow pickleball warm-up, then about 15 max-effort jumps. Slight knee pain after jumping.
Power clean 135 lb, back squat 4x9 at 160 lb, RDL 3x10 at 155 lb. Knee 1-2/10.
Back squat 4x9 at 160 lb and hip thrust 3x10.
